headline: 《歪心狼对阵ACME》《龙族》双线引爆九月
summary: 电影方面《歪心狼对阵ACME》口碑领跑，剧集方面《权力的游戏前传：龙族》持续霸榜；同时新剧《狂热先生》《早春晴朗》首播，待映《生化危机：爆发夜》引发期待。

industryHighlights.text: 《歪心狼对阵ACME》成为本周电影热作焦点
industryHighlights.en: Wile E. Coyote vs. ACME is the week's standout film

industryHighlights.text: 《权力的游戏前传：龙族》稳居热播剧榜首
industryHighlights.en: House of the Dragon tops the hot drama rankings

industryHighlights.text: 《狂热先生》《早春晴朗》等多部新剧本周首播
industryHighlights.en: New series including Mr. Mania and Early Spring Sunshine premiere this week

industryHighlights.text: 《生化危机：爆发夜》《猫鼬》等新片蓄势待映
industryHighlights.en: Upcoming films like Resident Evil: Outbreak Night and Meerkat are highly anticipated

headlineEn: Wile E. Coyote vs. ACME and House of the Dragon Heat Up September
summaryEn: On the film side, Wile E. Coyote vs. ACME leads the buzz; on TV, House of the Dragon keeps dominating. Meanwhile, new series Mr. Mania and Early Spring Sunshine debut, while upcoming Resident Evil: Outbreak Night sparks anticipation.
